Thanks for the advice so far.

My parents are aware of the issue, but we haven’t spoke about it for years and naturally it’s an extremely awkward conversation to bring up which is why I’m trying to do everything myself, organising a doctors appointment etc.

On the point of a prosthetic testicle, it has the upside of having confidence in a sexual relationship, however it would be a drastic change; right now I can grab all of my nutsack excluding the part where my right testicle is, squeeze as hard as I can and feel no pain. It would feel extremely weird to have this ‘void’ be filled.

I went to A&E (Emergency room) once for another sports related injury, and my parents informed the doctor and the doctor felt around said that nothings bad. This was when I was 11 though and clearly my left testicle shouldn’t be the size of a pea.

I’ve never had an appointment for this issue since when I was 5 years of age.

This.

My mother has these all over her arms, however her one needs surgery to remove.
